saw_lines: Owners rarely buy a CRM on impulse. They wait until the spreadsheet breaks, then ask a colleague before they trust anyone.
So sales are won in the first ad, where a cold buyer decides whether a Pipedrive partner is worth a click.
Your 29 live ads carry 0 proof numbers, so lead the next batch with one client result on the creative, such as projects delivered.

ads.source: Meta Ad Library, active ads, 13 Nov 2026
points: 0 of 29 ads carry a proof number, so a cold viewer has no reason to trust a Pipedrive partner. Collect one number from your client work, such as projects delivered, and open the next batch with it on the creative.
0 of 29 ads carry an offer, so a first time buyer has no reason to act today. Put a first order offer or a bundle in the first line of your next batch of ads.

20 different openings across 29 copy ads, and the biggest leads only 3. Buyers meet a new pitch each time, so no story repeats enough to build recall. Pick your best stories and build the next batch from them.

11 ads have run 60+ days, so they are your longest running base. Build 3 more variations of the oldest one, changing the opening line and the product detail, and keep its body copy. Run them beside it.
